creative_direction: Draw an original 28-year-old man seated beside a tram window at night, using a detailed but restrained anime illustration style. He has chestnut short hair, a straight nose, and an easy thoughtful expression, wearing a gray wool jacket over a black turtleneck. Frame the upper chest and head so his face remains large and readable. Reflections of passing city lights form soft teal and amber streaks on the window, never covering the eyes. Add fabric seams, fine hair groupings, and controlled cel shading without fantasy accessories or recognizable character design. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
